frames.observation: The exact custom base is readable in settled native snowman_idle as a broad faceted glacier pedestal at the target footprint. It supports the middle body, scarf, head and crown in one coherent stacked silhouette without a sampled gap or mesh explosion.

A later snowman_idle sample preserves the same base proportions and complete five-part stack. The pedestal remains centered under the torso with a consistent lower silhouette; exact floor collision is outside this image review.

At the telemetry-selected native AttackCrit trigger, the Root_M-weighted base remains centered at the target footprint while the upper stack begins its attack. The complete pedestal is visible above the foreground hero.

During native snowman_attack2, the broad base remains coherent under the articulated upper body while the attack effect spreads across the floor. Bright ice light changes its apparent color but does not reveal an obvious stretch or collapse.
The ordinary zero-focus attack begins with Rimecrown intact at HP58. The exact base remains centered under the complete stack before the native hero action resolves.
During native attack-slot resolution, the faceted pedestal and complete stacked silhouette remain readable. This precedes the measured HP transition and does not by itself establish hit motion.

The telemetry-selected native Damaged trigger coincides with the bright impact sphere and foreground hero. The base stays visible behind them at the target footprint, but the effect prevents fine inspection of its upper contact edge.

The recorded 10-damage label is visible during native snowman_damage. The upper stack lifts apart while the broad Root_M-weighted base remains at the target position without an obvious manufactured connector or long deformation. Smoke and the hero obscure part of its face.
After the damage reaction, the exact base again supports the recovered stack at HP48. Camera afterimages limit edge inspection, but the pedestal retains its intended broad shape.

The capture ends with the exact base and full stack intact while a lingering native ice effect remains around the hero. Telemetry has returned to snowman_idle and the pedestal shows no sampled identity or shape failure.

The explicit KillSingle capture begins with the exact base and complete Rimecrown intact at HP48. The ordinary hero UI remains visible, but this action is a separate fixture rather than ordinary lethal gameplay.

At the exact native Death trigger, the broad base remains visible behind the large impact effect and foreground hero. The glow prevents fine surface judgment, so this frame primarily establishes action provenance.

Native snowman_deathDirect is underway with the recorded 1000-damage label. Upper parts travel upward through smoke while the exact base remains visible at the target footprint. This is an animated fall-apart sequence, not ragdoll behavior.

The broad glacier base remains clearly readable as smoke fills the vacated upper target position. Its sampled shape stays coherent after the other parts separate, though this still does not measure exact terrain contact or collision.

The animated death continues with the exact base still visible and coherent after the upper stack leaves the useful camera area. The frame supports sampled base persistence only, not a lifetime or cleanup claim.

The native loot panel covers the target position. A base edge remains visible behind it, while the overlay prevents complete surface inspection. Exact telemetry still reports the base active, enabled, visible and identity-stable.

At the end of the complete 120-frame capture, the loot panel still blocks most of the target and the base is partly visible behind it. Exact telemetry remains stable, but this handoff does not establish later corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.

requirements: All 17 referenced original PNGs were inspected before assigning the reviewed status.
Every observation is scoped to the exact frame and its telemetry boundary.
The ordinary 58 to 48 hit is separate from the explicit 48 to 0 KillSingle fixture.
The source reports m_DoRagdoll false and zero rigidbodies, so the observed fall-apart death is animated and receives no ragdoll credit.

Exact base instance, owner, mesh and bone signature remain unchanged while active, enabled and visible in all 360 retained telemetry frames; exact terrain contact, collision, corpse lifetime and final cleanup remain unproven.
